reports.title: RAMBUS REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: 2026 Fourth Quarter Outlook
section:
(In millions, except per share amounts) | GAAP | Non-GAAP (1)
Revenue | $227 - $233 | $227 - $233
Product revenue | $127 - $133 | $127 - $133
Royalties revenue | $68 - $74 | $68 - $74
Contract and other revenue | $26 - $32 | $26 - $32
Total operating costs and expenses (2) | $143 - $139 | $124 - $120
Diluted earnings per share | $0.68 - $0.76 | $0.84 - $0.92
Total operating costs and expenses include cost of sales and operating expenses.

For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects revenue to be between $227 million and $233 million. The Company also expects product revenue to be between $127 million and $133 million, royalties revenue to be between $68 million and $74 million, and contract and other revenue to be between $26 million and $32 million. Revenue is not without risk and achieving revenue in this range will require that the Company sign customer agreements for various product sales and solutions licensing, among other matters.

The Company also expects GAAP operating costs and expenses to be between $143 million and $139 million and non-GAAP operating costs and expenses to be between $124 million and $120 million. The Company expects interest and other income to be $6.5 million. These expectations also assume a GAAP tax rate of 17.5%, a non-GAAP tax rate of 16% and a diluted share count of 109 million shares, and exclude stock-based compensation expense of $18.2 million, amortization of acquired intangible assets of $1.0 million and other one-time adjustments of ($0.2) million.
Additionally, the Company expects GAAP diluted earnings per share to be between $0.68 and $0.76 and non-GAAP diluted earnings per share to be between $0.84 and $0.92.
